name: get_contact
summary: Look up a person in Contacts.app by name and return their FULL card — every phone, email, postal address, birthday, and organization. Read-only. Use this when the user wants a contact's details beyond just a number (application-phone/find_contact returns numbers only). PRIVACY: a contact card is personal data; invoke it deliberately. Drives Contacts via AppleScript, so the first use may prompt to grant Automation access to Contacts.

params.name: name
params.description: Name (or part of a name) to search Contacts for.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max matching people to return (default 5, max 20).

name: create_contact
summary: Create a new person in Contacts.app. STAGED behind a confirmation token; reversible (undo deletes the exact contact this created). Supply at least one of first_name / last_name / organization, plus optional phone, email. Does NOT edit existing contacts — it only adds a new card.

params.name: first_name
params.description: The person's given name. Provide at least one of first_name, last_name, or organization.

params.name: last_name
params.description: The person's family name. Provide at least one of first_name, last_name, or organization.

params.name: organization
params.description: The company / organization the contact belongs to. Provide at least one of first_name, last_name, or organization.

params.name: phone
params.description: A phone number for the contact. Digits with an optional leading '+' and spaces/dashes/parentheses; no letters.

params.name: email
params.description: An email address for the contact, e.g. jane@example.com.
